_comment: Registry of validate-test benchmark cases. Each entry defines a nuclease/guide benchmark with a precomputed brute-force ground truth. To add a new example: append an entry, generate its reference with test/benchmark/generate_references.sh, host the TSV, and record its md5. validate.py iterates this registry, downloads+caches each reference (keyed by md5), and reports per-case pass/fail.

benchmarks.name: cas12a_hbg
benchmarks.source: HBG1/HBG2 clinical Cas12a guide (Blood 2019, doi:10.1182/blood-2019-130256); on-targets chr11:5249950 / 5254874
